title: Survey Response Generation: Generating Closed-Ended Survey Responses In-Silico with Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking and evaluating different technical methods for eliciting survey responses from Large Language Models (LLMs). While religious identity is mentioned as a demographic persona attribute in some survey prompts (e.g., in the ATP 2021 dataset simulation), the study does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its core research topic.
